## NEVER DO

- **NEVER** commit or push directly to `develop` or `main`. Always work on a feature/fix branch.
- **NEVER** force push (`git push --force`). If absolutely required, use `--force-with-lease`.
- **NEVER** make requests to, curl, query, or interact with production endpoints: `int.meesho.int`, `prd.meesho.int`, `int.mrouter.int`, `prd.mrouter.int`. These are production/pre-prod systems — any accidental call can affect live traffic or data.
- **NEVER** introduce backward-incompatible changes to public APIs, request/response schemas, Kafka/event contracts, database schemas, or shared config keys without explicit user approval. Downstream services and stored data may depend on current behavior — silent breakage in production is the failure mode.
- **NEVER** land a fork-local engine change as a `vendor/` edit alone. `vendor/go.opentelemetry.io/obi/**` is generated state: `make vendor-obi` — and therefore `make build` and `make verify` — regenerates it from the `.obi-src` submodule and silently discards your edit. The change must exist in the `.obi-src` repo first; then bump the submodule pointer and commit the regenerated `vendor/` diff in the same commit. `git show b4da5978` is the reference shape.
- **NEVER** modify files under `.obi-src/` and expect them to be tracked here. It is a git submodule pointing at `siddharth-pal-meesho/opentelemetry-ebpf-instrumentation` (branch `develop`) — changes must be committed and pushed in that repo, then pulled in via `git submodule update --remote` and re-vendored.
- **NEVER** add or rename a field on `pkg/beyla/config.go:Config` without handling both sides of the OBI conversion. `pkg/helpers/config/convert.go:Convert` matches by field name and **panics at startup** on any field present in one struct and absent in the other — a Beyla-only field must be listed as `cfgutil.SkipConversion` in `pkg/beyla/config_obi.go:FromOBI`.
- **NEVER** add a config field without regenerating the JSON schema (`make generate-config-schema`, needs an initialised `.obi-src`). `make check-config-schema` fails on a stale `docs/config-schema.json`.
- **NEVER** assume CI will catch a mistake on a `develop`-targeted PR. Every `pull_request_*` workflow is scoped to `branches: ["main", "release-*"]`, so a PR into `develop` runs **no** build, lint, unit tests, schema check, license check, or integration tests. Run `make lint` and `make test` locally before pushing.
- **NEVER** mutate a `beyla.Config` after something has called `AsOBI()` on it and expect the engine to see it — the converted OBI config is memoised on the struct.
- **NEVER** introduce a logging library. `pkg/` and `cmd/` use stdlib `log/slog` exclusively.
- **NEVER** rewrite `docs/sources/**` casually — it is the published Grafana documentation and is Vale-linted (`.vale.ini`, `vale.yml` workflow) with the Grafana style.

## Architecture

Beyla v3 is a **distribution of OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation (OBI)**, not a standalone agent: the probes, discovery and core exporters live in `vendor/go.opentelemetry.io/obi/`, pinned by a `replace` directive to the `.obi-src` submodule. This repo owns a Grafana-flavoured `Config`, the reflection bridge and naming overrides that translate it into OBI's world, a few extra pipeline stages, and a Kubernetes SDK-injection webhook. **Most behaviour questions are answered in `vendor/`; most configuration and naming questions are answered in `pkg/`.**

Before deciding *where* a change goes, decide *which side of the boundary* it is on — see [docs/wiki/pages/obi-integration/vendored-obi-boundary.md](docs/wiki/pages/obi-integration/vendored-obi-boundary.md).

## Repo layout

| Path | Owns |
|---|---|
| `cmd/beyla` | The agent binary — `main.go:main` |
| `cmd/k8s-cache` | Optional out-of-process Kubernetes metadata cache |
| `cmd/beyla-schema` | Build-time generator for `docs/config-schema.json` (needs `.obi-src`) |
| `pkg/beyla` | `Config` root, OBI conversion (`config_obi.go`), global naming overrides |
| `pkg/components` | Feature fan-out under one `errgroup` (`beyla.go:RunBeyla`) |
| `pkg/internal/pipe` | Beyla-owned swarm that embeds OBI's pipeline as a node |
| `pkg/export/{otel,prom,alloy}` | Beyla-specific exporters: survey, process, connector spans, Sigil |
| `pkg/webhook` | Experimental SDK-injection admission controller |
| `pkg/services` | Selection criteria and default exclusions |
| `pkg/helpers/config` | The reflection converter (`convert.go:Convert`) |
| `vendor/go.opentelemetry.io/obi` | **Generated.** The engine. Regenerated by `make vendor-obi`. |
| `.obi-src` | Git submodule — the engine's source. Empty until `make obi-submodule`. |
| `internal/test`, `internal/testgenerated` | Integration suites (the latter is generated, not in git) |
| `internal/tools` | Separate Go module pinning tool versions (golangci-lint, kind, envtest, …) |
| `docs/sources` | Published Grafana docs — Vale-linted |
| `devdocs` | Contributor notes; `pipeline-map.md` has the mermaid stage diagram |
| `charts/beyla`, `ops/` | Helm chart, Grafana mixin, runbook |

## Working in this repo

- **Fork context.** `origin` is `siddharth-pal-meesho/beyla`. Meesho work happens on `develop`, branched off as `feat/*` / `fix/*`; `main` tracks upstream `grafana/beyla`. Upstream Beyla itself is being donated to CNCF as OBI — non-doc fixes to *engine* behaviour belong upstream in the OBI repo, not here.
- **Two-layer feature gating.** The outer layer (`pkg/beyla/config.go:Feature` bitmask) decides which top-level goroutines start and is *derived from whether an exporter is configured*, not from a boolean. The inner layer (vendored `Features` bitmask, string names like `application_process`) decides which metric families each exporter emits. A missing metric *family* is usually the inner gate; a missing signal entirely is usually the outer one. See [feature-gating](docs/wiki/pages/telemetry/feature-gating.md).
- **Adding a pipeline stage** → register it in `pkg/internal/pipe/instrumenter.go:Build`; read [swarm-instancer-model](docs/wiki/pages/pipeline/swarm-instancer-model.md) first.
- **Adding a metric** → [api-dependency-counter](docs/wiki/pages/telemetry/api-dependency-counter.md) is the worked example of a fork-local one, caps and all.
- **Imports are grouped by `gci`** in this order: standard, default, `go.opentelemetry.io/obi`, `github.com/grafana`, local module. `make fmt` fixes ordering; `make lint` fails on it.
- **`cyclop` max-complexity is 12** and `gocritic` runs `rangeValCopy`/`rangeExprCopy`/`indexAlloc`/`commentedOutCode`. Commented-out code fails lint.
- **Tests** are plain `testing.T` + `stretchr/testify` (`assert`/`require`). Kubernetes-touching packages need envtest assets — run `make prereqs`, or scope to packages that don't (`go test -mod vendor ./pkg/beyla/...`).
- Every build/test invocation passes `-mod vendor` explicitly. A bare `go test ./...` may resolve differently.
- `GOOS`/`GOARCH` default to `linux`/`amd64` in the Makefile — `make compile` on macOS cross-compiles.

## Meesho Context

This is an open-source upstream repository (Apache-2.0, `grafana/beyla`) forked for Meesho use. It uses **none** of the Meesho platform stack — no go-core, mCache, mQ, mSearch, Prism, MySQL/Scylla/Redis, ZooKeeper, CAC config tree, `deployments/<deployable>.yaml`, or Jenkins/turbo-turtle pipeline. `deployments/` here holds Grafana's demo manifests, not Meesho deployment descriptors. There is consequently no `docs/downstreams.md` or `docs/infrastructure.md` — there is nothing for them to describe.

The only Meesho-specific surface:

### Git submodules

| Submodule | Path | Repo | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `obi-src` | `.obi-src/` | `https://github.com/siddharth-pal-meesho/opentelemetry-ebpf-instrumentation` (branch `develop`) | The OBI engine source. Carries not-yet-upstream fork changes (`api_dependency_total`, trace-graph/parenting fixes). Empty until `make obi-submodule`; changes require `git submodule update --remote` + `make vendor-obi`. |

### Fork-local engine changes currently carried

- `api_dependency_total` — entry-API → downstream-API edge counter, in `vendor/go.opentelemetry.io/obi/pkg/export/otel/api_dependency.go`, gated by the `application_api_dependency` feature.

## Quick reference

| Task | Command | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Init the engine submodule | `make obi-submodule` | Required before any generation target |
| Install dev tooling | `make prereqs` | golangci-lint, kind, envtest, gotestsum, bpf2go, dashboard-linter |
| Plain build (no re-vendor) | `make compile` | `bin/beyla`; cross-compiles to linux/amd64 by default |
| Build the k8s cache | `make compile-cache` | `bin/k8s-cache` |
| Full build (re-vendors first) | `make build` | ⚠ overwrites local `vendor/` edits |
| Re-vendor OBI | `make vendor-obi` | Needs Docker + an initialised `.obi-src` |
| Format + fix imports | `make fmt` | `golangci-lint fmt` (gofmt -s + gci) |
| Lint | `make lint` | `golangci-lint run ./... --timeout=6m` |
| Unit tests | `make test` | needs `make prereqs` for `KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS` |
| Scoped unit test | `go test -mod vendor ./pkg/beyla/...` | verified working without envtest |
| Regenerate config schema | `make generate-config-schema` | writes `docs/config-schema.json`; needs `.obi-src` |
| Verify schema is current | `make check-config-schema` | CI gate on `main`/`release-*` PRs |
| Coverage report | `make coverage-report` | after `make test` |
| Integration tests | `make integration-test` | Docker; also `integration-test-k8s`, `oats-test` |
| Helm chart tests | `make helm-unittest` | Docker |
| Java agent | `make java-verify` | spotless + test + build, via Gradle inside `.obi-src` |
| Everything | `make verify` | prereqs + lint-dashboard + vendor-obi + lint + test |
